requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: That agency's own case or citation number, where the record states one
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: That agency's own case or citation number, where the record states one
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no agency identifier is held for this record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the arresting agency's case or citation number, copied from the record where one is stated

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of arrest or citation, from the record
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of arrest or citation, from the record
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for this record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of arrest or citation, taken from the case papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Agency that made the arrest or issued the citation
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Agency that made the arrest or issued the citation
requiredBeforeFiling.why: an agency name is a case fact the participant obtains from the record, not a field the court owns
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the agency that arrested or cited you, taken from the case papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Cause number of the case, copied from the court record
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Cause number of the case, copied from the court record
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for this record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the cause or case number, copied from the court record; where the court assigns a new number for the expungement it is supplied at filing

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court that entered the conviction, named in the caption with its county or city
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court that entered the conviction, named in the caption with its county or city
requiredBeforeFiling.why: Mississippi has four trial court levels that all handle expungements and the convicting court is a case fact the participant establishes from the record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: which court entered the conviction - justice, county, circuit or municipal - and its county, or for a municipal court its city; the records office of that court can confirm both

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of the conviction, from the judgment
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of the conviction, from the judgment
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no disposition fact is held for this record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the conviction date, checked against the certified copy of the judgment of conviction - correct the packet if they disagree

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Petitioner's initials beside the first-offender statement
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Petitioner's initials beside the first-offender statement
requiredBeforeFiling.why: first-offender status is the whole eligibility test on this track and the platform does not certify it; a prior conviction or prior expungement routes to advice instead
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own initials beside the first-offender statement, only after you have checked your Mississippi criminal history record from the Mississippi Criminal Information Center and it shows no other conviction and no prior expungement

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Petitioner's initials beside the statement that the offence is not a traffic violation and is not a DUI
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Petitioner's initials beside the statement that the offence is not a traffic violation and is not a DUI
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the nontraffic classification is the participant's own assertion and is never certified by the platform
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own initials beside the nontraffic statement, only if it is true - many Mississippi misdemeanours sit near that line, and an uncertain classification is a reason to stop and get advice, not to initial

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of the offence, from the record
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of the offence, from the record
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no offence fact is held for this record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of the offence, taken from the case papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Offence of which the petitioner was convicted, worded as the court record words it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Offence of which the petitioner was convicted, worded as the court record words it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no charge fact is held for this record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the offence, worded exactly as the court record words it, with the Mississippi Code section where the record states one

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Agency that made the arrest or issued the citation, as the order must direct it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Agency that made the arrest or issued the citation, as the order must direct it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the agency list of the order is a set of fillable fields from the participant's own record, never hardcoded
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the arresting or citing agency's name, from the case papers, so the order reaches its records

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Cause number in the caption of the proposed order
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Cause number in the caption of the proposed order
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for this record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same cause number as the petition's caption

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court named in the caption of the proposed order, with its county or city
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court named in the caption of the proposed order, with its county or city
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the convicting court is a case fact the participant establishes from the record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same court and county (or city) as the petition's caption

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Any other person or agency keeping an official record of the case, to be named in the order
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Any other person or agency keeping an official record of the case, to be named in the order
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the agency list of the order is participant data from the record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: any other office the case papers show keeping an official record of the arrest or the conviction

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Sheriff's department of the county, where its records carry the case
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Sheriff's department of the county, where its records carry the case
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which county's records carry the case is a case fact from the participant's own record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the county sheriff's department, where its records carry the case

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Mailing address at which the prosecuting authority was served
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Mailing address at which the prosecuting authority was served
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no address for the prosecuting authority is held, and a guessed address on a certificate would be false
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the mailing address of that office, confirmed with the court's records office before service

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Prosecuting authority served, written as the court record names the office
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Prosecuting authority served, written as the court record names the office
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the prosecuting authority is participant data and is never defaulted; the archived model's fixed address is deliberately not reused
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: which prosecuting authority handled the case - the district attorney for the circuit district, or the county or municipal prosecuting attorney; for a municipal court case it is the city prosecutor, and the court's records office can confirm the office

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Cause number in the caption of the certificate of service
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Cause number in the caption of the certificate of service
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for this record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same cause number as the petition's caption

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court named in the caption of the certificate of service, with its county or city
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court named in the caption of the certificate of service, with its county or city
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the convicting court is a case fact the participant establishes from the record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same court and county (or city) as the petition's caption

protectedBlanks.why: the petitioner signs the petition personally

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the petitioner's signature on the petition
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the petition is signed would be false

protectedBlanks.label: Entered, this the day of - the entry line of the order
protectedBlanks.why: the Court alone dates and enters the order

protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the copy actually goes out would be false

protectedBlanks.label: Signature of the petitioner on the certificate of service
protectedBlanks.why: the petitioner signs the certificate when the copy actually goes out
